items.title: Typecheck / lint / build
items.precondition: Execution branch with deps installed; migration applied
steps: npm run typecheck
npm --prefix frontend run lint
npm --prefix frontend run build
items.expected: All three exit 0 for this change.
items.evidence: npm run typecheck, frontend lint (oxlint warnings only), frontend build exit 0 on kylie/chat-themes at finalization.

items.title: Thread header opens theme picker
items.precondition: Signed-in user in an open 1:1 thread
steps: Open /messages/:conversationId
Confirm palette or theme icon in thread header beside peer info
Tap the icon
Confirm theme picker sheet/modal opens with preset categories
items.expected: Picker reachable from thread only; inbox unchanged.
items.evidence: Verified during execution session: Palette icon in thread header opens unified picker modal.

items.title: Apply bundled graphic preset
items.precondition: A1; two mutual friends Alice and Bob in same thread
steps: As Alice, pick a graphic preset (e.g. Romance or Holiday)
Confirm thread background, bubble colors, and composer button accent update
As Bob in same thread (second browser/session), confirm theme matches without reload after socket event or refresh
items.expected: Shared conversation theme; both participants see the same design.
items.evidence: Theme apply + socket sync verified during execution; graphic presets render via CSS gradients.

items.title: Apply solid color or gradient
steps: Open theme picker Colors & Gradients section
Select a solid background color
Confirm bubbles and accent update
Switch to a two-stop gradient preset
Confirm background shows gradient and bubbles remain readable
items.expected: Solid and gradient modes work; text contrast readable in light and dark app theme.
items.evidence: Solid swatches and gradient presets apply with contrast-adjusted bubble foreground colors.

items.title: Reset to default theme
steps: Open theme picker
Choose Default / Reset
Confirm thread returns to standard B&W styling
items.expected: NULL theme restores platform default styling for both participants.
items.evidence: Reset option clears theme to platform defaults.

items.title: Word effect plays on send
items.precondition: Open thread; word-effects catalog includes e.g. love, congrats, happy birthday
steps: Send a message containing a trigger word (e.g. congrats)
Confirm animation/effect plays in the bubble when message appears
Peer session confirms same effect visible on received message
items.expected: Curated word→effect mapping; both sides see effect; plain text body unchanged in API.
items.evidence: Bubble-scoped overlay/inline effects verified for love, congrats, fire, wow triggers.

items.title: Non-participant cannot change theme
items.precondition: API client with session for user C; conversation between A and B
steps: PUT /api/messages/conversations/:id/theme with valid preset as user C
Observe 403 or equivalent deny
items.evidence: ChatThemeService + controller enforce participant-only access; same pattern as thread GET.
items.notes: Formal two-user API curl not re-run at -d; authz follows existing messenger participant gate.

items.title: Invalid theme payload rejected
steps: PUT theme with unknown presetId
PUT theme with invalid hex color or script injection in color field
Observe 400 validation errors
items.expected: Zod/service validation; no arbitrary CSS stored.
items.evidence: Zod schemas in chatThemeSchema + allow-list preset IDs reject invalid payloads.
items.notes: Formal negative API curl not re-run at -d.
